title: Restriction preserves coherent coefficient transitions
statement: Let I and J be preorders, t : J → I a functor, D : Iᵒᵖ → Scheme an inverse scheme diagram, and F_i abelian étale sheaves on D_i with transitions φ_f : (D(fᵒᵖ))^*F_i → F_j. Suppose φ has the identity and composition laws displayed in [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-stage-continuity]. Define the restricted coefficients at j to be F_{t(j)}, transported along D_{t(j)} = (tᵒᵖ ⋙ D)_j, and restricted transitions at f to be φ_{t(f)}, with the corresponding reflexive type transports. Then these concrete restricted transitions satisfy both the identity and the upperStar composition law for tᵒᵖ ⋙ D. No nonemptiness, directedness, finality, affineness, limit, or continuity assumption is made.

source.place: Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), agent-written coefficient restriction step in lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-cohomology-affine-stage; source page https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YQ read on 2026-10-12.

proof.text: Construct the restricted coefficients and transitions by the explicit formulas in reindexEtaleCoefficients and reindexEtaleTransitions. These are reflexive equality transports of F(t.obj j) and φ(t.map f), not objects chosen from an existence theorem.
For identity, rewrite t.map(𝟙 j) as 𝟙(t.obj j), apply the supplied identity law at t.obj j, cancel the reflexive transports, and identify the scheme functor identity equality by proof irrelevance.

For composition, rewrite t.map(f ≫ g) as t.map f ≫ t.map g. Apply the supplied composition equation at t.obj i, t.obj j, t.obj k. The two scheme transition maps and their composite agree with those of t.op ⋙ D; cancel transports and use proof irrelevance for its map_comp equality.

theorem reindex_etale_transition_coherence
    {I J : Type u} [Preorder I] [Preorder J]
    (t : J ⥤ I)
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    :
    (∀ i : J, (reindexEtaleTransitions t D F φ) (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ((t.op ⋙ D).map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        ((reindexEtaleCoefficients t D F) i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ((t.op ⋙
        D).obj (op i))).hom.app ((reindexEtaleCoefficients t D F) i)) ∧
    (∀ (i j k : J) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      (reindexEtaleTransitions t D F φ) (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ((t.op ⋙ D).map g.op) ((t.op ⋙ D).map f.op)
          ((t.op ⋙ D).map (f ≫ g).op) ((t.op ⋙ D).map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app
        ((reindexEtaleCoefficients t D F) i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ((t.op ⋙ D).map g.op)).map ((reindexEtaleTransitions
        t D F φ) f) ≫ (reindexEtaleTransitions t D F φ) g)
